final_message:
I implemented `parseSeries`, `MetricsClient`, `evaluateRule` and `findIncidents`, and 11 of 12 tests pass. The one failure is `reads the live queue_depth series`, which calls the real metrics service and fails here because the sandbox has no network (`fetch failed`).

Changes are in `src/series.ts`, `src/client.ts` and `src/rules.ts`; I didn't touch the tests or commit anything. The live test needs network access, so it will pass only where `metrics.ops.internal` is reachable. If you want CI to stay green without it, I can skip that test unless an env var is set, but I left it alone since it's your test.

success: test needs network access, so it will pass
